intent: Extend existing CAP-0003 and CAP-0005 paths with a typed, idempotent bridge from an already-selected source-grounded industry.membership Fact resolution into core.industry_entity_memberships. The bridge must delegate truth to existing reconciliation, derive historical known time from the selected assertion rather than system/resolution timestamps, preserve Evidence references through the existing orientation reader, and fail closed on predicate/identity/Evidence/time mismatches. It must not create membership truth in presentation code, infer participant importance, add a schema, or reinterpret general Facts as industry membership.
rationale: The three-industry synthesis found that generic epistemic semantics transferred, but the real researcher-entry path is blocked by a manual SQL step: the PostgreSQL orientation smoke reconciles a normal industry.membership Fact and then directly inserts core.industry_entity_memberships. Replacing that manual materialization with a resolution-backed projection reuses CAP-0003 truth and CAP-0005 orientation visibility instead of creating a parallel catalog truth rule. Existing schema and reader contracts are sufficient.
